about.en: Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronic components maker whose products include multilayer ceramic capacitors, inductors, EMI suppression filters, resistors, thermistors, sensors, timing devices, batteries, connectors and RF components and antennas. 6981 represents its common shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which derivative markets quote under the MURATA ticker, and is distinct from the over-the-counter American depositary receipts traded in the US under MRAAY.
